prospective_screening.order: Record all query results and pagination limits; screen in source creation-time order rather than choosing only successful reproductions.
prospective_screening.inclusion: A documented acceptance/reporting defect with immutable source anchors and a replayable local input, or an explicitly marked non-defect applicability control.

unit_of_analysis: Independent repaired defect; variant inputs and repeated commands remain nested within it.
pooling_rule: Do not pool different execution lanes into a single end-to-end accuracy rate.
obligations: Freeze policy thresholds, report filters, required checks and applicability before each future evaluation. Label native semantics separately from consumer acceptance.

labels.requirement: Two annotators blinded to method outputs; disagreement retained. This has not yet been performed.

baselines: current fixed native tool with actual policy
ordinary script with the same receipts/configuration and debugging budget as the candidate
holdout: Group by repaired defect and tool family. Do not split variants of one repair across development and held-out sets. No held-out set is selected or executed yet.
stop_rules: If ordinary strict scripts match the candidate, retain engineering value without a new-algorithm claim.
If only known authored cases support the claim, report a development pilot or experience study rather than generalization.
Do not count legal skips, empty selections or policy-permitted warnings as native defects.
